reason: The root cause is geometric. Default content is 644 px (en/ko/zh_CN) or 667 px (ja), plus 64 px of margins, against a 648 px page. No scroll offset can show both the logo and the footer at that size, so Title must get shorter at short viewports. _fit_to_viewport works from 'bare' height: the content minimum minus the logo's own height and all current gaps (3 content gaps, 7 menu gaps). Because bare does not depend on the previous fit, refits converge. A refit triggered by the fit's own minimum_size_changed recomputes the same values and applies nothing. If the default layout (18/12/150) fits within viewport-64-2, the defaults are restored, so 1400x950 and 1400x942 are unchanged. Otherwise the separations become 12/8 and the logo is clamped to 88..150. EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE with KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED scales the whole artwork, so the logo shrinks instead of being cropped. Expected heights at 1152x648 are about 134 px for en/ko/zh_CN and 111 px for ja, giving a total of about 646 px, which is at or under 648, with the footer fully visible. Under enlarged text the logo reaches the 88 px floor and the rest scrolls as before. The existing Play guard and follow_focus are kept. No nodes, text, fonts, colors, assets, hierarchy or actions change, and menu_screen.gd is untouched. All scheduling uses one-shot process_frame connections to methods on this Title instead of await, so Godot drops them automatically when the Title is freed, and both callbacks guard is_inside_tree() for the removed-but-not-yet-freed window during router _replace. This also removes the v2 coroutine-resume-on-freed risk. Refit triggers: initial build, viewport size_changed, and content.minimum_size_changed. The last one covers live locale wrapping, width-driven rewrap and late label settling. No Preferences callback is added because the router already rebuilds Title on preference changes.
